title: Acceptance: finance_summary
prompt: Contract: finance_summary(expenses, budget) returns {"total", "count", "top", "remaining", "warning"} where total is rounded, top is the category with the highest total (tie -> first to reach it; None when empty), remaining = round(budget - total, 2), and warning is True when total > 0.9 * budget else False.

tests.name: the full report
tests.code:
expenses = [
    {"amount": 50, "category": "food", "note": ""},
    {"amount": 20, "category": "fun", "note": ""},
    {"amount": 30, "category": "food", "note": ""},
]
r = finance_summary(expenses, 100)
assert r["total"] == 100.0 and r["count"] == 3, f"got {r}"
assert r["top"] == "food", f"tie at 80? no: food 80, fun 20. got {r}"
assert r["remaining"] == 0.0, f"got {r}"
assert r["warning"] is True, "100 > 90% of 100"
r2 = finance_summary([], 50)
assert r2["top"] is None and r2["warning"] is False and r2["remaining"] == 50, f"got {r2}"
r3 = finance_summary(expenses[:1], 100)
assert r3["warning"] is False, "50 is exactly half — no warning"
r4 = finance_summary([{"amount": 2, "category": "b"}, {"amount": 3, "category": "a"}, {"amount": 2, "category": "a"}, {"amount": 3, "category": "b"}], 20)
assert r4["top"] == "a", f"tie 5-5, a reached its 5 first: {r4}"
tests.hint: two accumulators: totals and first-index-seen per category; top = min by (-total, first_seen).
